## Proposed change
Fix the climate devices, this was a bug that was introduced by the rewrite of the velbus component in 2021.10 release
This requires a dependancy bump AND changes in the component

Dependency changes:
https://github.com/Cereal2nd/velbus-aio/releases/tag/2021.10.7
